historical_Figma_handoff.verification: Creation return records and the actual VP05 screenshot confirm partial design only. Zero prototype reactions were committed; no clickable prototype or human-walkthrough result is claimed.
historical_Figma_handoff.remaining: Restore available Figma MCP quota, repair the existing nodes, finish native state/navigation and isolate four demo contexts, then verify all five flows and provide a real prototype link for owner S04-05 operation.
historical_Figma_handoff.shared_state: Public maturity/gates/tasks, product code, dependencies and tools/3d-proof were not changed. Keep S04-02/04/05 unpassed.
historical_Figma_handoff.current_audit: The generation pipeline omitted the industrial shell/layout basis and substituted narrative cards for 18 of 24 main workspaces. Professional/Collab read calls remain rate-limited. Do not rerun the old generator or treat resume-layout.js as sufficient.
